title: Algerian Date Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful North African stew made with tender dates and sweet velvety sauce, served with a side of crusty bread.
instructions: Heat the velvety in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the algerian and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the dates, date syrup, and water to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Serve over crusty bread or couscous for a filling meal.
